entries.original_text_or_value: Evaluate the following statements. I. Cells in G0 remain metabolically active. II. In animals, mitotic division is seen only in diploid somatic cells. III. In some lower plants and some social insects, haploid cells divide by mitosis. IV. Heart cells of adult animals divide continuously to replace cells lost through injury. Which set contains all and only the correct statements?
entries.problem_found: Statements II and III (both NCERT lines) sit uneasily together (animal mitosis only in diploid cells vs haploid mitosis in social insects); key A still unique.
entries.verification_source: Rationalised NCERT Biology XI/XII; independent blind re-solve

entries.original_text_or_value: Which of the following were known or proposed by the early experimenters? I. Plants use light energy to make carbohydrates from CO2 and water. II. O2 evolved by green plants comes from CO2. III. In green plants H2O is the hydrogen donor and is oxidised to O2. IV. The green substance of plants is located in special bodies later called chloroplasts. Choose the correct option.
entries.problem_found: 'Early experimenters' is vague; III is van Niel's proposal (in NCERT Early Experiments section) so I,III,IV; if van Niel excluded, C (I and IV) becomes defensible
entries.verification_source: Rationalised NCERT Biology XI/XII; independent blind re-solve

Organic agriculture is one of the three options for increasing food production. Which statements are correct?
entries.problem_found: All four statements are true per NCERT (GMO definition, Green Revolution yields mainly from improved varieties, reduced post-harvest losses, organic agriculture as an option); no option lists I-IV. B chosen only if I is deemed false.

entries.original_text_or_value: Consider the following statements. I. Population size is more technically called population density and is designated as N. II. entries.problem_found: Statement IV 'mostly estimated indirectly' overstates NCERT (which says total number is generally the most appropriate measure); key still D as III is clearly false

entries.original_text_or_value: Statement I: Gross primary productivity is the biomass remaining with producers after their respiratory utilisation. Statement II: Secondary productivity is the rate of assimilation of food energy by the consumers.

entries.verification_source: Rationalised NCERT Biology XI/XII; independent blind re-solve
